rationale: The agent did not follow the required flow. Although it initiated user lookup, there is no clear authentication confirmation. It executed write actions (removing an item and then canceling the same order) without first confirming with the user, violating the policy to confirm every order-changing action. It also canceled the whole order despite the user’s condition to cancel only if item removal is not possible. The request to modify the skateboard (material/size/graphic) was not carried out—only an order details fetch appears—with no confirmation or outcome shared. The request for total prices of paid grills was not addressed. The final message is a generic thank-you and provides no results or confirmations. These issues constitute failure under the pass criteria.
